content: Nice and easy puzzle to understand, especially for beginners. The warehouse theme is a good start, but i think it could be a bit more interesting with an extra twist or a stronger story behind it. Right now the solution is very straightforward

It's a good idea for a clash, but I already played a clash looking like this puzzle, 
It sjould be great to add maybe a rule that player must only considered one time each number and add the possibility of having mutly times the same number in the string given at the start.
but it's a good idea. better for a clash than a puzzle

General
* Too easy as a puzzle. Please re-create the contribution as a clash of code.

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly by following the example there (e.g. use << >> to format line numbers and keywords in bold, use [[ ]] for variables).

Constraints
* Please avoid overstating the possible range of values. Currently, as [[n]] never exceeds 10, 1000 would not be an appropriate upper bound.

Cases
* Please use the value ranges from the Constraints section in a more balanced way. At the moment, most cases use only small values except for one outlier.

* Please incorporate more varied random numbers instead of relying on values that follow an arithmetic progression.

* The current tests and validators consistently focus on the same scenario while varying inputs and outputs slightly, which works well. Please preserve this approach when revising existing cases or adding new ones.

Thanks.
